firstPlayerRule: The group chooses an active player for the first turn. Players collectively choose who acts on every turn, and the same person may act again if everyone agrees.
houseFallback: If the group cannot agree on the first active player, choose one at random.
clarifications: On later turns, if the group cannot agree, the player to the left of the previous active player takes over.
